note: Command templates for external tools. The harness does not bundle or install anything; a check whose executable is absent is reported BLOCKED, never passing.

adapters.rationale: Rule-based SAST that scans in seconds and lets you write repository-specific rules. Weakest on cross-function logic flaws.
Highest precision dependency scanning against the OSV database. Suitable as a per-change gate because it is fast and low noise.
Breadth in one binary: dependencies, container images, infrastructure as code, secrets, and licences. Better as a scheduled sweep than a per-change gate.
History-aware secret detection. Complements the built-in fitness rule, which only sees the current working tree.
Produces the artifact inventory that later vulnerability rescans and provenance attestation depend on.
Detects personal data in text and structured data. Its own documentation states it cannot find everything, so treat it as one layer rather than a boundary.
Measures whether the tests would actually catch a defect. Run it per change with incremental mode; a nightly-only signal arrives after the change has already merged.
Generates adversarial requests from the API schema, covering inputs no hand-written case would include.
Asserts latency and error-rate objectives under load. Its result binds to a deployed version rather than to a diff.
Infrastructure misconfiguration is where availability and security failures usually originate rather than in application code.
Validates service level objectives declared as code so the availability target is reviewable and machine-readable.
